_comment: AGENT: always read this file via the task-index-manager skill before reading or writing any task state. System tracker for ai-worldbuilder (ADR 002).

tasks.title: Cell registry 4/5: repair cell, whole-world backup pair, logout gate, verify
tasks.notes: repair <cell>: back up ONLY the impacted region files (region holding the cell plus any region its features/trees/decor spill into, from *-cells.json footprints and masks) together with that cell's registry record; wipe only that cell's columns to air above bedrock; replay from the registry clipped to the cell bounds (ghost ground/features if ghost state, else ground, features in registry order, trees, decor; features from site/builds specs); re-raise marker if it was up; if any step fails, clear flags for that step and all later ones so next picks it up. 'undo repair' restores the region files and the saved registry record. Bake-off: wipe the WHOLE world each round, restore ONE whole-world backup paired with a whole-registry copy (no per-cell slices); update model_bakeoff.restore_ghost_step and region_backup. Raw region_backup restore of a partial snapshot is refused (error points at the proper undo/redo command) except via repair-undo and the full-world bake-off restore. LOGOUT GATE: every command that rewrites region files (repair, undo repair, bake-off wipe/restore, dryrun_reset) refuses without --confirm-logged-out, stops and plays the need-you sound asking the user to log out; second guard checks session.lock / a running server holding the save and refuses even with the flag. VERIFY (report only, exit non-zero on any error): invariants; marker rings vs registry (exactly the marked cell has a stripe ring); region files exist for cells with ground and no blocks in cells the registry calls empty; built features have ownership files and blocks still present; registered features have specs; OSM buildings no registered feature covers (warnings that block DONE until resolved or dismissed with a reason); leftover old-system files (STAGES, QUEUE, CURRENT-CELL, sign-offs). Hook verify into scripts/run_tests.py / dryrun_reset where sensible.

tasks.title: Cell registry 5/5: reset worlds, update template, final audit of rules/docs/skills/tests
tasks.notes: MIGRATION: world data is volatile. Update dryrun_reset for the registry (delete region files, STAGES, QUEUE, CURRENT-CELL, handoff pending, holds, sign-offs, AERIAL-REVIEW, old verification/site build records), reset worlds/southampton-build through it, start with an empty registry that the tools populate, regenerate the ghost frontier around the origin cell, run verify clean. Update templates/new-world-site/ and skill new-world-build to scaffold the registry. Note: worlds/southampton-build config still points at the donor SouthamptonAI save and the bake-off save shares site records; make sure the registry paths are per active world. COMPLETION GATE (the work is not done until this audit is clean): hunt down and update every rule, script, skill, doc, ADR, template and test that the registry changes or invalidates - at minimum rules/process.md (s1, s2c, s2e, s5), handoff-layered-passes.md (also fix stage vocabulary and ghost ring docs), feature-builds.md, foliage.md, radial-good-enough.md, rules-context.md, building-review.md, craftsmanship.md; skills cell-orchestrator, redo, human-confirm-fix, new-world-build, model-bakeoff; docs/specs/lidar-ghost-v2-and-dryrun-reset.md, docs/adr/003, docs/model-bakeoffs.md; AGENTS.md, GLOSSARY.md (add cell, feature, registry terms); the ~58 scripts/test_*.py (test_lidar_ghost, test_site_handoff, test_site_status, test_site_recover, test_cell_marker, test_cell_features, test_touched_cells, test_dryrun_reset, test_coverage, test_world_frame, test_cellmath, test_region_backup, test_site_pages, test_site_archive, test_redo_here, test_model_bakeoff ...). Grep for removed names (STAGES, QUEUE, CURRENT-CELL, handoff, signoff, AERIAL, CELL-HOLDS, focus_cell, ORIGIN_CELL) must come back empty or justified. Run scripts/run_tests.py green.
